pages.text: Costs one ability slot, 16 ectoplasm, 16 pixie dust, three leads and three signs. Released dragons are immune to in-wall suffocation and cramming and cannot damage terrain. When stuck for about a second while following or pursuing, a dragon can step across a nearby obstacle if there is room for its whole body on the other side. This cannot cross bedrock, the world border or unloaded chunks. Hitboxes, reach and ordinary AI stay unchanged.
